symptom: `create or modify workflow` from `describe workflow` output deletes every notification activity (`Workflows$NotificationActivity`) and reports "Created workflow" — no refusal, `mx check` clean
cause: The reader had no case for NotificationActivity, so it became a GenericWorkflowActivity that describe prints as a `-- [Workflows$NotificationActivity]` comment; the rewrite guard (`checkNoDroppedWorkflowConstructs`) counted boundary events, ends and sub-processes but not this activity, so nothing noticed it was missing from the statement
insight: A `-- [Workflows$…]` comment in describe output is a guard gap until proven otherwise: whatever describe cannot state, a rewrite from that output deletes. Grep the describer's generic fallback against the guard's counters when adding either. Measured with the previous build on an 11.13 copy: one stored activity, zero after the rewrite; the ESP guard had masked it in the Studio Pro reference workflow, which also held a sub-process.
